Spoke to @AJEnglish just before the ceasefire; Explained that more threats and attacks by Trump lead to more resistance by Iran. Maximum pressure has not produced surrender from Iran since the first Trump term. In fact, it produced the exact opposite, as the Iranians say maximum resistance, and that is why we got here.

Trump thinks everyone has a threshold for threats and pressure, so eventually will give up. But I don’t think this next level of escalation will bring what he wants, which is ful

Told CNN that there is a sigh of relief in Iran and across the region including here in Doha after the ceasefire. Iran was the underdog in this war but put up a big fight against two super powers and was able to force some of its conditions.
Thank you @BeckyCNN

Video

Spoke to BBC World radio about President Trump’s deadline to Iran, how genocidal rhetoric has horrified a nation of 90+ million, in a war that has expanded across the Middle East and led to a global energy crisis. 
open.spotify.com/episode/1dB…

Joined Aljazeera to discuss possibilities to end the war. For Iran this war is a continuation of the June 2025 war when they were attacked by Israel and the U.S., accepted a ceasefire, then were attacked again in less than a year. Now they want to end the war permanently so it doesn’t come back again.

Video

I told Aljazeera that Iran is unlikely to just give up its golden card that is the Straight of Hormuz. Iran is the underdog in a war where two nuclear powers attack them, but it is not a paper tiger and continues to escalate horizontally in an asymmetric war.

Video

Told Aljazeera that Trump’s strategy of “maximum pressure” has not brought surrender from Iran but instead has produced what Iranians coined as “maximum resistance”.
